note: In-vehicle radio (Phase 6). Every station, host, advert and product here is fictional. Tracks are PLACEHOLDERS generated live in the browser by a small synth ('pattern'); nothing is streamed from a real station and no commercial song is included. To drop in licensed music later, give a track a 'src' (an audio file URL or path served with the game) and set 'placeholder' to false: the game plays the file instead of the pattern. Only add music you have a licence for.

stations.name: Lagoon FM
links: Lagoon FM, 88.6. If you are stuck in go-slow on Harbour Road, we are stuck with you.
That one was for everybody at the bus park this evening.
Keep it locked. More grooves after this.

stations.name: Harbour Talk

links: Traffic update: Harbour Road is moving slowly near the workshop. Patience, my people.
